scripts.build:package: npm run build:frontend && rm -rf backend/dist build && cp -r frontend/dist backend/dist && pyproject-build
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:backend:fix && npm run lint:frontend:fix
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:backend:check && npm run format:frontend:check
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd .. && pip install -e .[dev]
